guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Set Up a Solana Wallet and Fund it
guide.description: Install a Solana wallet such as Phantom, Solflare, or Backpack. You need SOL for network fees and USDC (or $CARDS) to open Gacha packs. If you don’t have any, buy them on Binance or use the bridge below Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Visit Collector Crypt and Sign In
guide.description: Go to the Collector Crypt platform and sign in with your email or wallet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Open Gacha Packs to Earn Points
guide.description: Open packs through the Gacha Machine using USDC or $CARDS. This is the core activity that builds your points balance. Each pack reveals a tokenized card you can keep, trade, sell back instantly, or redeem for the physical version.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Join Weekly Gacha Games Challenges
guide.description: Take part in the weekly Gacha Games for badges and a share of points prize pools. These themed challenges reward consistent participation and add to your quarterly standing.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Hold $CARDS for Monthly Airdrops
guide.description: Buy $CARDS on Raydium (contract: CARDSccUMFKoPRZxt5vt3ksUbxEFEcnZ3H2pd3dKxYjp) and hold it to qualify for the separate monthly holder airdrops. Holding also lets you pay for packs in $CARDS.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Share Your Referral Link
guide.description: Generate your referral link on the platform and use it when onboarding others. Current-quarter referral points carry a bonus, so active referrals can meaningfully raise your allocation.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim Your Rewards
guide.description: When a quarterly distribution goes live, claim through the official page and connect the wallet you used for activity. The Q2 2026 rewards were processed on June 14, with 15,000,000 $CARDS (0.75% of total supply) allocated across the ecosystem. Review and claim your allocation at claim.collectorcrypt.com .
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
